title: Safe for {short}.
Simple for its teams.
why.lead: Five things built into the platform, from staging to production.

items.title: Detailed policies
items.text: Roles, limits and which actions need a person, set for each agent.

items.title: On-premises deployment
items.text: Runs in {short}'s own data centre or private cloud.

items.title: Isolated sandboxes
items.text: Code that agents generate runs in sealed, isolated environments.

items.title: Visual builder, no code
items.text: Business teams build and change agents themselves.

items.title: Easy integration
items.text: API and MCP in and out. Any API becomes an MCP node on the FireFlow graph.

gate: {short} keeps control of its data and rules, and its own teams ship new agents.
